# ADR-{NNNN}: {Decision title in active voice}

> **Output file location:** `docs/decisions/ADR-{NNNN}-{slug}.md`.
> One file per decision. `docs/dev-docs/DECISIONS.md` serves as the index, not a place
> to pile all decisions — a monolithic file cannot be referenced per-decision by agents,
> has no individual status, and does not show which decisions have been superseded.

**Status:** {Proposed / Accepted / Superseded by ADR-NNNN / Deprecated}
**Date:** {YYYY-MM-DD}
**Decision makers:** {name / role}
**Related:** {ADR-NNNN, ARCHITECTURE.md §N, requirement ID}

---

## Context

{What is happening that requires this decision. Facts and constraints,
not solutions. 1–3 paragraphs.

Include real constraints: budget, timeline, team size, team capability, contractual
obligations, legacy systems that cannot be touched. Architecture decisions are almost
always consequences of constraints, and without recording them, a reader six months
later will conclude this decision was stupid.}

---

## Options considered

### Option 1: {name}
- Pros: {…}
- Cons: {…}
- Cost: {time / money / complexity}

### Option 2: {name}
- Pros: {…}
- Cons: {…}
- Cost: {…}

### Option 3: {name}
{…}

> At least two options. An ADR with one option is not a decision, it is an announcement — and
> provides no information to the next reader.

---

## Decision

{One paragraph: we chose Option N, because {main reason tied to the constraint in
Context}.}

**What becomes easier:**

**What becomes harder:**
- {…}

**What is now forbidden because of this decision:**
- {…}

**Cost to reverse this decision later:**
- {Low / Medium / High — and roughly how much effort}

## Impact on other artifacts

Check what needs to be updated as part of this ADR (not later):

```
□ ARCHITECTURE.md §{N}
□ CONVENTIONS.md
□ VERIFY.md (new gate or threshold)
□ OWNERSHIP.md (new path owner)
□ contracts/{file}
□ docs/dev-docs/DECISIONS.md (add to index)
□ docs/dev-docs/TECHNICAL-DEBT.md (if this is a temporary decision)
```

---

## When this decision should be revisited

{Concrete trigger, not "periodically". Examples: "when tenant count exceeds 500",
"when p95 latency of the order endpoint exceeds 800ms", "when the team grows beyond 8 engineers",
"when vendor X announces deprecation".}
